title: 户外游乐设备基础

intro.background: 户外大型游乐设备是教玩具厂的高毛利产品。主要包括：组合滑梯（Combination Slide）、攀爬架（Climbing Frame）、秋千（Swings）、钻爬隧道（Tunnels）、游戏屋（Playhouse）、体能训练设施（Physical Training Equipment）。结构材质常见有：镀锌钢管（Galvanized Steel）、高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）、不锈钢（Stainless Steel）、木材。非标定制（Custom Non-standard）是核心竞争力——客户给场地照片，你设计一套独一无二的设备。
intro.desc: 掌握户外游乐设备的产品词汇、材质和非标定制概念。
outcomes: 能引导客户做非标定制

oneLiner.en: Outdoor playgrounds are custom-engineered structures — every slide length, climbing net and fall height must comply with EN1176.
oneLiner.cn: 户外游乐设备是定制工程结构——每个滑梯长度、攀爬网、下落高度都必须符合EN1176。

vocab.ex: Our best seller is the 6-meter combination slide.
vocab.exCn: 我们的畅销品是6米组合滑梯。

vocab.ex: The climbing net is made of UV-resistant nylon rope.
vocab.exCn: 攀爬网用抗紫外线尼龙绳。

vocab.ex: We offer bucket swings for toddlers and belt swings for older kids.
vocab.exCn: 我们有幼儿桶式秋千和大孩腰带式秋千。

vocab.ex: The main structure is hot-dip galvanized steel, anti-rust for 10 years.
vocab.exCn: 主体结构是热镀锌钢管，10年防锈。

vocab.ex: HDPE panels are colorfast and UV-resistant.
Stainless steel slides are popular for premium projects.
vocab.exCn: 不锈钢滑梯在高端项目很受欢迎。

vocab.ex: The maximum fall height must be below 2 meters for kindergarten.
vocab.exCn: 幼儿园最大下落高度必须低于2米。

vocab.ex: We recommend EPDM rubber surfacing under the equipment.
vocab.exCn: 我们建议设备下用EPDM橡胶地面。

mistakes.right: Our slide complies with EN1176-1:2017, with a fall height of 1.5 meters and EPDM surfacing below.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说'安全'。客户要的是标准号、具体参数。

basic.en: The main structure is hot-dip galvanized steel.
The slide is made of stainless steel.
We can customize the design based on your site.
basic.cn: 我们可以根据您的场地定制设计。

basic.en: The fall height is about 1.5 meters.

advanced.en: This combination unit features a hot-dip galvanized steel frame, 304 stainless steel slides, UV-stabilized HDPE panels, and a nylon climbing net — fully certified to EN1176 by TUV.
advanced.cn: 这套组合设备采用热镀锌钢架、304不锈钢滑梯、抗UV HDPE板、尼龙攀爬网——TUV全项EN1176认证。
advanced.from: The slide is made of stainless steel.

advanced.en: We offer non-standard customization: send us your site dimensions or photos, and our design team will produce a 3D rendering within 5 working days.
advanced.cn: 我们提供非标定制：发您场地尺寸或照片，我们设计团队5个工作日内出3D效果图。
advanced.from: We can customize the design based on your site.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We need a play structure for our new kindergarten playground.
lines.cn: 我们新幼儿园操场需要一套游乐设备。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Great. Could you share the available area and age group? For example, a 200 sqm area is ideal for a combination slide with climbing frame.
lines.cn: 好的。您能告诉我们可用面积和年龄段吗？比如200平米适合做组合滑梯+攀爬架。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: About 150 square meters, kids aged 3 to 6.

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Perfect. We can design a non-standard unit with a stainless steel slide, climbing net, and a small playhouse. Main frame is galvanized steel, EN1176 certified. Shall I send a 3D proposal?
lines.cn: 好的。我们可以设计一套非标设备：不锈钢滑梯+攀爬网+小游戏屋。主架镀锌钢，EN1176认证。我发个3D方案给您？

scenario.q: A customer wants a play structure for a 200 sqm kindergarten yard. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: For a 200 sqm area, I recommend a combination unit with a 3-meter stainless steel slide, a climbing net, and a small playhouse. The main frame is hot-dip galvanized steel, EN1176 certified. We can customize the colors and theme to match your kindergarten brand. Shall I prepare a 3D proposal and quotation?
scenario.cn: 200平米我推荐组合设备：3米不锈钢滑梯+攀爬网+小游戏屋。主架热镀锌钢，EN1176认证。颜色和主题可按您园所品牌定制。我准备3D方案和报价？

checklist: 我能描述镀锌钢/HDPE/不锈钢材质

culture.title: 非标定制是教玩具外贸的核心竞争力
culture.content: 和标准品不同，户外游乐设备几乎都是'一园一设计'。客户买的不是SKU，而是'我们家幼儿园独一无二的设备'。流程：客户发场地照片/平面图 → 你问面积、年龄段、主题偏好 → 设计师出3D效果图 → 客户改3轮 → 确认方案 → 报价 → 签合同 → 生产 → 海运 → 现场安装。这个周期通常2-4个月。会做3D设计、能用英语解释设计理念的业务员，客单价能翻倍。

aiPractice.situation: 澳洲客户李女士要在悉尼做一个幼儿园户外项目。

rounds.ai: We want something special for our new kindergarten. Can you do custom designs?
rounds.cn: 我们想给新幼儿园做个特别的。你们能定制吗？
rounds.hint: 强调非标定制能力，5天出3D。

rounds.ai: The yard is about 180 square meters, kids 3-5 years old. What do you recommend?
rounds.cn: 场地约180平米，3-5岁。推荐什么？
rounds.hint: 推荐组合滑梯+攀爬+游戏屋，镀锌钢+不锈钢。

rounds.ai: Is the equipment certified for the Australian market?
rounds.cn: 设备有澳洲市场认证吗？
